cardOverview.overviewText: A travel-focused card offering 3x Membership Rewards points on flight and hotel bookings, complimentary travel vouchers worth ₹10,000, and milestone benefits. Additional perks include priority services at partner hotels and comprehensive travel insurance coverage.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: Experience unmatched service with 24x7 Platinum Assist and Emergency card replacement, anywhere in the world.
benefitRows.howToAvail:
The American Express concierge service number is 1-800-525-3355.
You can also call the number on the back of your card and say "Concierge" when prompted.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy exciting discounts of up to 20% every time you dine at select restaurants.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the dining partner’s app or website using your registered account. Explore available dining and order-in offers, select your preferred meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy exclusive dining privileges. Complete the payment using your American Express Platinum Travel credit card to unlock the offer.
